summary: Sprint 12.1 /bank-accounts CRASH FIX RETEST — PASSED. E1's maskedAcct() helper works: mobile /bank-accounts renders the full 12-item bank list with masked account numbers (A/C XXXXXX3306, XXXXXX8868, XXXXXX8059, etc.), NO ErrorBoundary, ZERO JS errors. However E1 half-applied the fix: line 143 (list render) uses maskedAcct(b) correctly, but line 78 (delete-confirm Alert) STILL directly called `bank.account_number.slice(-4)` — same TypeError source. Testing agent applied a one-line null-safe fix to line 78 (uses the same maskedAcct(bank) helper). ADD → VERIFY flow works E2E: added new bank (holder=Regression Tester, IFSC=HDFC0001234, acct ending 1187) → row appears with 'A/C XXXXXX1187 · Not verified' → tap 'Verify (Penny Drop)' → row flips to 'Verified via demo · 100% match' with 'Make Primary' + 'Re-verify' buttons showing. Regression: /gold, /mutual-funds, /(tabs) all render with no ErrorBoundary. Only lingering console noise is React-Native-Web 'Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder' warnings — pre-existing framework noise, not this sprint.

Testing agent applied one-line fix using the existing maskedAcct(bank) helper. Verified: no crash, no ErrorBoundary.

ui_bugs.issue: The Pressable wrapping the Trash2 icon has no testID (all sibling actions do — ba-verify-*, ba-primary-*, ba-add). Should have testID={`ba-delete-${b.bank_id}`} for automation. Currently forces DOM-tree traversal for testing which is fragile.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testID={`ba-delete-${b.bank_id}`} on the trash Pressable (bank-accounts.tsx around line 153) so future automation can click delete deterministically without SVG path-matching.

OPTIONAL (defense-in-depth): The maskedAcct(bank) helper is the source of truth — grep the codebase for any other bank.account_number.slice(...) references (`grep -rn 'account_number' /app/frontend/`) to make sure the withdrawal form, primary-picker etc. don't have the same latent bug. This retest only covered bank-accounts.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: E1's fix was correct in spirit (added maskedAcct helper + JSDoc) but applied to only one of the two call sites — always grep for every `.account_number` occurrence when fixing this class of contract-drift bug.

The list .map() (line 126) still has no defensive per-row error boundary; one malformed row would still take down the whole screen (same pattern as iter37 admin /audit crash). Consider wrapping each Card in a small ErrorBoundary or filtering invalid records before .map().

rca_of_issue: RCA — iter38 identified one crash source (line 134 in list .map). E1 fixed it via new maskedAcct() helper + JSDoc, but only applied it to the list render (now line 143). The IDENTICAL bug at line 78 (`****${bank.account_number.slice(-4)}` inside the `remove()` Alert.alert title arg) was overlooked. That call site would only be exercised on trash-icon tap — since iter38 crashed before render, no one hit it there; but as soon as the list rendered, tapping delete would crash again with the same TypeError. Mitigation applied (one-line): `${bank.bank_name} · ****${bank.account_number.slice(-4)}` → `${bank.bank_name} · ${maskedAcct(bank)}`. maskedAcct already null-safe. Zero risk since helper is the single source of truth (line 23-27).
